title: How to Personalize Content for Different Accounts Without Hiring More People
theme: How to Personalize Content for Different Accounts Without Hiring More People
thesis: Learn how B2B marketers can personalize content for different accounts at scale, without adding headcount, using AI orchestration to drive engagement and pipeline from prompt to pipeline.
summary: Learn how B2B marketers can personalize content for different accounts at scale, without adding headcount, using AI orchestration to drive engagement and pipeline from prompt to pipeline.
proof_points: Marketers can launch campaigns 50% faster and achieve 10x engagement without hiring more people.
According to industry data (2023), 72% of B2B marketers found CRM systems most beneficial for tailoring marketing efforts, highlighting the importance of data-driven segmentation.
Folloze's Campaign Agent, an integral part of its AI orchestration platform , enables 5x faster campaign creation by intelligently generating content boards, ads, and email copy.
For instance, Conga attributed $6.3M in pipeline from just six campaigns built on two Folloze boards, demonstrating significant impact with lean resources.
